text:
elaine: Heads-up — quick copy + a11y review for the Embeddings » Buckets empty state. Product wants a friendly nudge for first-time users + keyboard/aria advice. attaching options below.

mike: thanks. can we keep it short — users often land here via API errors. also want the CTA to indicate upload vs create.

sasha: Short + scannable. want explicit mention of file/formats? maybe a tooltip link to docs.

elaine: here's a few variants i drafted. please react with :one: :two: :three: or comment inline. also included aria-label suggestions.

elaine: Option 1 (friendly):
"Your embeddings bucket is empty. Upload vectors from CSV, JSONL, or use the SDK to generate them.
[Upload vectors] [See docs]"
aria-label for CTA: "Upload embeddings vectors"

elaine: Option 2 (developer-forward):
"No vectors found. Create a bucket and upload your embedding files, or generate vectors with the Redwood SDK.
[Create bucket] [Generate with SDK]"
aria-label for primary CTA: "Create embeddings bucket"

elaine: Option 3 (error-first):
"No embeddings. If you expected vectors here, check your ingestion pipeline or retry the upload.
[Retry upload] [View ingestion docs]"
aria-label primary: "Retry embeddings upload"

mike: Quick thoughts: I like Option 2 for clarity. "Create bucket" vs "Upload vectors" — we need to be consistent with other screens (we use "Create" elsewhere for buckets). Also make the primary CTA keyboard-focusable and first in DOM.

oliver: Accessibility nit: primary CTA text should describe the action, e.g. "Create embeddings bucket" (not just "Create"). Also ensure the helper link isn't in the same tabindex order as the primary CTA — put docs after, with `rel="noopener"`.

elaine: good call. Sasha — for the inline docs link, should we show a tooltip on hover with short supported formats?

sasha: yes, lightweight tooltip is fine. Tooltip content: "Supported formats: CSV (id, vector), JSONL (each line: {id, embedding}), or use SDK to stream vectors." Keep it under 120 chars.

mike: one more product ask: add microcopy for the empty list table header when bucket exists but has zero items: "No vectors yet — upload or generate" (small).

elaine: accessibility checklist (proposed):
- primary CTA has aria-label equal to extended text: "Create embeddings bucket"
- tooltip is accessible: `role="tooltip"` + visible on focus
- ensure empty-state is reachable via keyboard (tab stops)
- add live region for uploads: `aria-live="polite"` for status updates

oliver: +1. Also recommend we include a short alt text for the empty illustration: "Illustration: empty box with arrow pointing up" (for screen readers mark as decorative unless we rely on it to convey meaning).

design-bot: deploy note — UX copy review tag applied: `design/reviewed`.

elaine: final proposal (combines feedback):
Headline: "No embeddings yet"
Body: "Create a bucket and upload vectors (CSV, JSONL), or generate embeddings with the Redwood SDK."
Primary CTA: "Create embeddings bucket" (aria-label: "Create embeddings bucket")
Secondary: "Upload vectors" (aria-label: "Upload embeddings vectors file")
Docs link: "Supported formats" -> opens tooltip / docs page
Table empty row text: "No vectors yet — upload or generate"
A11y notes: put tooltip after CTAs in DOM, tooltip has `role=tooltip` and appears on focus, primary CTA first tabbable element, add `aria-live="polite"` to upload status region.

mike: looks good. can someone add the final copy to the Figma component and ping me?

sasha: will do, i'll also add the tooltip copy and a11y annotations in the figma notes.

elaine: thanks — i'll update the PR with the string keys: `embeddings.empty.headline`, `embeddings.empty.body`, `embeddings.cta.create`, `embeddings.cta.upload`, `embeddings.table.empty`.
